workflow: When asked 'what are you doing?' in an idle session, saying plainly that nothing has been done and no files were touched avoids implying the pre-existing uncommitted changes are the assistant's work.

friction: The session had no defined task, so there was nothing to analyze or summarize beyond the existing working-tree state.
The listed modified files could be mistaken for session output, but they were already uncommitted before the session began.
